# Oberfucking

| image_caption                   = An Oberfucking sign pictured in 2010
}}
Oberfucking is a populated place in Upper Austria, Austria.
It is a part of the town St. Marienkirchen in district Schärding, near the border to Germany.  Oberfucking has 38 inhabitants (by January 2020).
Oberfucking has often been included in lists of places with unusual names, due to the fact that part of its name bears a similarity to the English-language expletive "fuck".
